name: Mawa Cake
subtitle: dense cardamom cake made with reduced milk, sold by every Irani bakery

ingredients.note: mawa; it is what makes this a mawa cake and not a sponge
generous; the cake should smell of it across the room

prepNotes: Mawa cake is deliberately dense. If it comes out light and airy, something has gone wrong.
Crumble the khoya finely and warm it slightly so it blends rather than sitting in lumps.

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the crumbled khoya.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well between each.
Fold in the flour, soda and ground cardamom, then loosen with the milk to a thick dropping consistency.
steps.tip: Fold, do not beat. Beating at this stage is what makes it rise like a sponge, which is not what this is.

steps.text: Pour into a lined tin, scatter the almonds and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.
Test with a skewer at the centre; a few moist crumbs are right, wet batter is not.
Cool completely in the tin before cutting.

storage: Keeps 4 days in an airtight tin at room temperature and is better on day two. It contains egg and milk, so refrigerate in hot weather.
